customer_payments_reversed_check.name: customer_payments_reversed_check
customer_payments_reversed_check.value:
"status" <> 'reversed'
       OR ("reversed_at" IS NOT NULL
           AND "reversed_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
           AND "reversal_reason" IS NOT NULL)

customer_payments_confirmed_check.name: customer_payments_confirmed_check
customer_payments_confirmed_check.value: "status" NOT IN ('confirmed','reversed') OR "confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL

dsr_subject_identifier_check.name: dsr_subject_identifier_check
dsr_subject_identifier_check.value: "customer_id" IS NOT NULL OR "user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "subject_reference" IS NOT NULL

dsr_resolution_check.name: dsr_resolution_check
dsr_resolution_check.value:
(("status" IN ('resolved','rejected')) = ("resolved_at" IS NOT NULL))
       AND ("status" NOT IN ('resolved','rejected') OR "resolution" IS NOT NULL)

deliveries_completed_check.name: deliveries_completed_check
deliveries_completed_check.value:
("status" = 'completed') = ("delivered_at" IS NOT NULL)
       AND ("status" <> 'completed'
            OR ("delivered_to_name" IS NOT NULL AND "delivered_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL))

diagnostics_terminal_coherence_check.name: diagnostics_terminal_coherence_check
diagnostics_terminal_coherence_check.value:
(("status" = 'completed') = ("completed_at" IS NOT NULL))
       AND (("status" = 'cancelled') = ("cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL))
       AND ("status" <> 'cancelled' OR "cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

feature_flags_scope_semantics_check.name: feature_flags_scope_semantics_check
feature_flags_scope_semantics_check.value:
("scope" = 'global' AND "tenant_id" IS NULL AND "plan_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("scope" = 'plan' AND "tenant_id" IS NULL AND "plan_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("scope" = 'tenant' AND "tenant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "plan_id" IS NULL)

feature_flags_window_check.name: feature_flags_window_check
feature_flags_window_check.value: "enabled_until" IS NULL OR "enabled_from" IS NULL OR "enabled_until" > "enabled_from"

im_adjustment_reason_check.name: im_adjustment_reason_check
im_adjustment_reason_check.value:
"movement_type" NOT IN ('adjustment_in','adjustment_out')
       OR ("reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("reason") <> '')

im_order_link_check.name: im_order_link_check
im_order_link_check.value: "movement_type" NOT IN ('consumption','return') OR "service_order_item_id" IS NOT NULL

media_assets_purge_order_check.name: media_assets_purge_order_check
media_assets_purge_order_check.value: "purged_at" IS NULL OR ("deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purged_at" >= "deleted_at")

mid_provider_message_id_check.name: mid_provider_message_id_check
mid_provider_message_id_check.value: "provider_message_id" IS NULL OR length("provider_message_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128

mi_accepted_coherence_check.name: mi_accepted_coherence_check
mi_accepted_coherence_check.value:
("status" = 'accepted' AND "accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accepted_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "accepted_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("status" <> 'accepted' AND "accepted_at" IS NULL AND "accepted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "accepted_membership_id" IS NULL)

mi_revoked_coherence_check.name: mi_revoked_coherence_check
mi_revoked_coherence_check.value:
("status" = 'revoked' AND "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "revoked_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("status" <> 'revoked' AND "revoked_at" IS NULL AND "revoked_by_membership_id" IS NULL)

memberships_status_coherence_check.name: memberships_status_coherence_check
memberships_status_coherence_check.value:
("status" <> 'active' OR "revoked_at" IS NULL)
       AND ("status" <> 'suspended' OR "suspended_at" IS NOT NULL)
       AND ("status" <> 'revoked' OR "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

qa_flow_check.name: qa_flow_check
qa_flow_check.value:
(
         "channel" = 'public_whatsapp_otp'
         AND "authorization_token_id" IS NOT NULL
         AND "authorization_challenge_id" IS NOT NULL
         AND "recorded_by_membership_id" IS NULL
       ) OR (
         "channel" <> 'public_whatsapp_otp'
         AND "authorization_token_id" IS NULL
         AND "authorization_challenge_id" IS NULL
         AND "recorded_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
       )

quotes_cancelled_coherence_check.name: quotes_cancelled_coherence_check
quotes_cancelled_coherence_check.value:
("status" = 'cancelled') = ("cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)
       AND ("status" <> 'cancelled'
            OR ("cancelled_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL))

receptions_closed_at_check.name: receptions_closed_at_check
receptions_closed_at_check.value:
("status" = 'open' AND "closed_at" IS NULL)
       OR ("status" IN ('closed','cancelled') AND "closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

soi_warranty_window_check.name: soi_warranty_window_check
soi_warranty_window_check.value: "warranty_expires_at" IS NULL OR "warranty_start_at" IS NULL OR "warranty_expires_at" > "warranty_start_at"

soi_completed_check.name: soi_completed_check
soi_completed_check.value:
"status" <> 'completed'
       OR ("completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "quantity_billed" IS NOT NULL)

soi_adjustment_reason_check.name: soi_adjustment_reason_check
soi_adjustment_reason_check.value:
("source" <> 'manual_adjustment' AND "warranty_origin" <> 'order_override')
       OR ("adjustment_reason" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("adjustment_reason") <> '')

signatures_parent_xor_check.name: signatures_parent_xor_check
signatures_parent_xor_check.value:
("reception_id" IS NOT NULL AND "delivery_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("reception_id" IS NULL AND "delivery_id" IS NOT NULL)

vehicle_owners_one_primary_uq.name: vehicle_owners_one_primary_uq
vehicle_owners_one_primary_uq.where: is_primary = true AND valid_to IS NULL
